# Antiseptic: Scrap & Ticks Locations with Map

![Antiseptic: Scrap & Ticks Locations with Map](/uploads/530_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

In the daily and weekly challenges it is often necessary to recycle scrap for antiseptic. There are various items that come into question. And there are also various spawn points left by enemies (especially ticks), scrap with antiseptic as loot.

## Antiseptic scrap items

- Abraxo cleaning products (in all variants)
- Autopsy board game
- Blood sac (e.g. from blood beetles)
- Empty blood sack (e.g. from the flesh sacks of super mutants)
- Industrial solvent
- feed juice (scrap)
- Tick blood bag
- Toothpaste
- Turpentine
- scrap antiseptic

## Antiseptic opponents

- Ticks (tick blood bag)
- Honey Beasts (Forage Juice: Scrap)

## Places with antiseptic scrap

-Sunshine Meadows
- North Kanawah Lookout
- Morgantown Airport
- Greg's Mine Supply
-Helvetia
-Summersville
- Mount Blair depot
- Whitespring
-Foundation
- National Funk Radio Station
- Harpers Ferry
-The Retreat
-Dolly Sods
-Red Rocket Mega Station
- Palace of the Twisted Path

- *etc. see map*
